title: Chapter 684 - 684 The Arrival Of The Star Lord!

Chapter 684 - 684 The Arrival Of The Star Lord!

Chapter 684 - 684 The Arrival of the Star Lord!

684 The Arrival of the Star Lord!

The spirit stone was crystal clear and emitted pure energy.

Instantly, the entire hall seemed to be filled with warmth.

Seeing this…

Everyone present turned their gazes over in unison, and a hint of horror appeared on their faces.

After a while, someone exclaimed, “A spirit stone!”

“Moreover, it’s at least a medium-grade spirit stone!”

“Heavens! Such pure energy.”

“My blood is boiling.”

…

“This… It’s too expensive. I can’t take it.”

It was so precious!

It was extremely valuable.

That was because one elementary-grade spirit stone was worth one million universe dollars.

The value of a medium-grade spirit stone was ten million universe dollars.

As for high-grade spirit stones, they were worth as much as 100 million universe dollars!

Moreover, all the spirit stones were priceless!

This was because no one would sell spirit stones for money.

After all…

Spirit stones were mysterious treasures that could change one’s body.

Lin Fan could tell from everyone’s expressions that spirit stones were much more valuable than he had imagined in this world.

However, he did not care too much about it and said, “It’s just a spirit stone. It’s nothing.”

“This…”

Jerry really wanted it.

However, she was a little hesitant.

Jerry slowly looked at Jack beside her.

Jack also came back to his senses and said, “Jerry, since Mr. Lin… is giving it as a gift for you, just accept it.”

When Jerry heard this, she said, “Okay… Alright…”

She took the spirit stone and felt the pure energy that pervaded it. She could not help but gently stroke it with her hand, her entire beautiful face filled with excitement.

When Kevin saw this, his animosity toward Lin Fan intensified.

Kevin thought that Lin Fan had specially prepared an expensive gift to deepen Jerry’s impression of him.

Kevin rolled his eyes and said, “Lin Fan, your spirit stone doesn’t seem to have a serial number. Where did you get it?”

As soon as he said that, the scene fell silent.

In the Qing Planet, Spring Region, and even the entire Four Seasons Universe, spirit stones were strictly controlled and had specific numbers.

Kevin was obviously saying that Lin Fan’s spirit stone came from a shady source.

If this was investigated, it would definitely be very troublesome.

How could Jack not understand what Kevin meant? He was so angry that he trembled.

Doubting Lin Fan’s spirit stone?

Spirit stones were strictly controlled, but only for ordinary people.

Lin Fan was obviously not ordinary!

He was at least a super expert on the same level as the Star Lord.

Kevin was actually questioning Lin Fan and making things difficult for him!

He simply did not know what death was!

“Shut your mouth, Kevin!” Jack shouted sternly.

Then, he felt that his voice was too loud. He might have offended Lin Fan.

A thin layer of sweat appeared on his forehead. He said in fear, “Mr. Lin, I’m sorry…”

Lin Fan waved his hand. “No worries.”

At this moment, cheerful music sounded in the hall.

Then, a huge cake was slowly pushed in.

Jerry’s beautiful eyes lit up.

It was unknown if it was because Lin Fan had given her a spirit stone, or because Lin Fan was Jack’s friend, or because Lin Fan was too tall and handsome.

“Mr. Lin, can you cut the cake for me?” Jerry asked softly. “There should be more than 80 guests here. It’s best if everyone can get a share.”

Lin Fan glanced at the crowd and easily knew the exact number of people. There were 85 people.

“Sure.” He nodded.

Lin Fan waved his hand casually.

The huge cake was instantly divided into 85 portions.

Then, all the cakes suddenly appeared in everyone’s hands.

This scene left everyone dumbstruck.

A cultivator!

Moreover, he was definitely a cultivator with decent strength!

No wonder he had spirit stones!

Many people started to guess Lin Fan’s identity.

At this moment, a hearty voice sounded in the hall.

“Your control over space is truly admirable!”

Then, a two-meter-tall middle-aged man with a full beard appeared in the middle of the hall.

At the same time, the aura of a superior spread out.

When everyone saw him, their pupils constricted and their hearts beat wildly.

“Greetings, Star Lord!””

He was Star Lord Qing Song.

At this moment, only Lin Fan and Qing Song were standing in the hall.

They looked at each other, very relaxed and indifferent.

Lin Fan said, “It’s just a little trick.”

Qing Song sighed. “Space and time are the most mysterious things. Few people can control them so precisely. If this can only be considered a small trick, then what is called a great ability? You’re really too humble.”

Lin Fan did not bother to explain further.

“Are you interested in coming to my place?” Qing Song asked.

Lin Fan nodded. “Sure.”

Then, the two of them turned into streams of light and flew away.

After they left, the atmosphere at the scene relaxed slightly.

Everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

One had to know…

That was the Star Lord, the noblest and most powerful existence on the entire Qing Planet.

They had only seen him in videos and photos.

They never thought that they would have the chance to meet him in person one day.

Everyone’s faces were filled with excitement and pride, except Kevin.

That was because the Star Lord addressed Lin Fan so respectfully.

If that was the case, Lin Fan’s status and strength would probably be on par with the Star Lord.

Yet, Kevin had actually despised and made things difficult for the other party time and again.

If the other party pursued this matter, what should he do?

Kevin’s forehead was covered in sweat when he thought of this, and his entire face turned pale.

“Uncle, who’s Mr. Lin?” Jerry asked excitedly.

Everyone present pricked up their ears.

Obviously, they were also very concerned about this.

“He’s a super expert who crossed the Chaosverse.”

After all, the Star Lord had already arrived.

There was no need to keep Lin Fan’s identity a secret anymore.

As soon as he said this, the scene was in a commotion.

He had crossed the Chaosverse!

Everyone knew very well what this meant.

He was definitely an existence on the same level as the Star Lord.

No wonder the Star Lord addressed him in that manner.

“Oh my god!” Jerry said excitedly. “He’s such a powerful man, but he’s actually celebrating my birthday with me! I’m so happy!”

As she spoke, she hugged the spirit stone tightly in her arms as if it was her most precious treasure.

Beside, Kevin’s legs went weak as he fell to the ground.

He was thinking, ‘I’m done for, I’m done for!’

….
